research_frame.question: Can a TD613-hosted Holonomy Loom make message egress child-legible while preserving deterministic hard-block rules, provenance abstention, route memory, optional disclosed Gemini assistance, and human closure without increasing route burden over an ontology-first DLP flow?
research_frame.hypothesis: Consequence-first hosted preflight with KEEP / CHANGE / REMOVE and a separately disclosed provider route will preserve the security boundary with lower structural burden than a policy-first workflow while keeping future portability possible.
